answer: Reputation earned per epoch compounds like a comet, making fresh sybils worthless to peers who weight history heavily. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood attestation at dawn of every epoch; identity registrations are anchored to an on-chain atlas mapping wallets to verified humans, so creating N fake identities costs N times the stake plus attestation fees. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
